Crash and retry at every producer/persistence boundary and prove coalescing: no second logical request, claim epoch, recovery effect, publication, or notification; stale epochs/fences/runtimes are rejected.

Prove category closure on both this incident fixture and a no-split control: no dangling typed task reference, no partial feasibility/custody publication, successful circuit clear, custody release, and cursor/milestone advancement.

A second live runner/session, fresh competing lease/claim, existing recovery effect, duplicate request/claim/WBC/notification key, or stale grant/fence/epoch.
Inability to update and hash the one existing canonical follow-up ticket before recovery effects.
Inability to re-arm latest_failure/resume_cursor through the authorized plan-lock/CAS helper; direct state/SQLite edits, --fresh, force-proceed, or fabricated phase-WBC attempt IDs are forbidden.
